title: Global HR Services, Specialist
description:
Global HR Services, Specialist


This role is pivotal in delivering a smooth and efficient employee experience across the employee lifecycle. As a Specialist within Global HR Delivery, you will support high‑quality HR operations by ensuring accurate HRIS processing, timely service outcomes, and consistent employee and manager support, while partnering with key stakeholders to maintain strong service standards and continuous improvement.


  
* Manage day‑to‑day administration and maintenance of employee records in the HRIS for new hires, existing employees, and exiting employees.
* Execute Hire‑to‑Retire transactions such as onboarding, employee data changes, letters, and separation actions.
* Provide employee and manager support through self‑service guidance and helpdesk responses.
* Prepare, process, and maintain HR documents and letters using standard templates (offer letters, confirmations, verification letters, etc.).
* Coordinate with payroll to ensure timely and accurate processing related to new hires, changes, and exits.
* Support background verification and reference check processes as per defined guidelines.
* Generate, review, and analyze HR reports (headcount, attrition, leave balances, compliance metrics).
* Ensure compliance with internal HR policies, data privacy norms, and statutory requirements.
* Identify and resolve data issues or case exceptions by partnering with HRIS, Payroll, Security, and other teams.
* Maintain high levels of data accuracy, documentation hygiene, and “first‑time‑right” processing.
* Contribute to process improvements, SOPs, and knowledge documentation.
* Support additional HR operational processes as required.

  
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in Human Resources or related field.
* Relevant HR operations / HR shared services experience (5\-8 years).
* Exposure to global HR processes is an added advantage.

Core Competencies \& Skills


* Knowledge or proficiency in HRIS platforms (Oracle, Workday, SAP, SuccessFactors).
* Analytical skills with the ability to validate information and prepare reports.
* Proficiency in MS Excel.

BGV:


* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.
